name: Discrete Fixed Membranous Subaortic Stenosis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Discrete Fixed Membranous Subaortic Stenosis Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of a discrete fibrous or fibromuscular membrane below the aortic valve detected by echocardiography
Demonstration of a fixed subaortic pressure gradient on Doppler echocardiography
No evidence of valvular aortic stenosis or other causes of left ventricular outflow obstruction
Presence of exertional dyspnea, chest pain, or syncope supportive but not mandatory

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of a discrete subaortic membrane with a fixed left ventricular outflow tract gradient and exclusion of valvular aortic stenosis
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis primarily relies on echocardiographic imaging and hemodynamic assessment.

searchTerms: constant pressure difference below aortic valve

common.notes: Due to left ventricular outflow obstruction
Chest pain related to myocardial ischemia
Transient loss of consciousness due to reduced cardiac output

searchTerms: heart muscle hypertrophy on left side

occasional.notes: Due to arrhythmias secondary to obstruction
Heard on auscultation over the left sternal border
searchTerms: ejection murmur heard on chest exam

occasional.notes: Secondary to elevated left ventricular filling pressures

rare.notes: Due to membrane extension affecting aortic valve
Rare complication involving the subaortic membrane

imaging: Echocardiographic visualization of discrete subaortic membrane
Doppler echocardiography showing fixed left ventricular outflow tract gradient
other: Cardiac catheterization confirming pressure gradient if noninvasive imaging inconclusive

distinguishingFeatures: Obstruction at the level of the aortic valve rather than subaortic region
Valve leaflet thickening or calcification on imaging
Asymmetric septal hypertrophy without discrete membrane
Dynamic obstruction that varies with loading conditions

redFlags: Progressive left ventricular outflow obstruction with worsening symptoms
Signs of heart failure or syncope on exertion
references: Maron BJ, et al. Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy and Subaortic Stenosis: Clinical and Pathological Features. Circulation. 2020.
Orphanet: Discrete Fixed Membranous Subaortic Stenosis (ORPHA:99051)
Moss AJ, et al. Clinical Cardiology: Diagnosis and Management. 2022.
